en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a lakeside recreation area. In the foreground, a dirt road runs along a fence with many bicycles leaned against it and several people standing or walking, some in swimsuits, others in everyday 1930s‑style clothing. A small wooden hut stands by the fence, possibly serving as a changing cabin or kiosk. Beyond the fence is a grassy shoreline with tall trees and more people relaxing near the water. On the right, a tall flagpole stands at the water's edge, flying a light‑over‑dark horizontal bicolor flag. Across the lake are open fields and a forested background.
